points.title: 王室公主
points.description: 玛丽一世于1516年2月18日在格林尼治宫出生，是英格兰国王亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳的女儿。作为天主教徒，她从小接受严格的天主教教育，精通多国语言，包括拉丁语、法语、西班牙语和意大利语。尽管她是亨利八世的合法继承人，但父母婚姻的破裂使她的地位岌岌可危。这一时期，玛丽作为王室公主的身份虽然尊贵，但也因父母婚姻危机而面临不确定性。
points.descriptionEn: Mary I was born on February 18, 1516, at Greenwich Palace, as the daughter of King Henry VIII of England and Catherine of Aragon. Raised as a devout Catholic, she received a rigorous Catholic education and became fluent in multiple languages including Latin, French, Spanish, and Italian. Despite being Henry VIII's legitimate heir, her position became precarious due to the breakdown of her parents' marriage. During this period, Mary enjoyed the status of royal princess but faced uncertainty due to the marital crisis of her parents.

points.title: 被废黜的公主
points.description: 1527年，亨利八世试图与凯瑟琳离婚以迎娶安妮·博林，导致玛丽被宣布为私生女，并被剥夺了公主头衔和继承权。她被从宫廷中驱逐，与母亲分离，生活条件大幅下降。尽管如此，玛丽仍然坚持自己的天主教信仰，拒绝承认父亲作为英国教会最高权威的地位。这一时期，她经历了从尊贵公主到被废黜的巨大落差，但她的坚定信仰和政治立场也逐渐形成。
points.descriptionEn: In 1527, Henry VIII sought to annul his marriage to Catherine to marry Anne Boleyn, leading to Mary being declared illegitimate and stripped of her title as princess and heir to the throne. She was banished from court and separated from her mother, experiencing a significant decline in her living conditions. Despite this, Mary remained steadfast in her Catholic faith and refused to acknowledge her father as the Supreme Head of the Church of England. During this period, she experienced the dramatic fall from royal princess to deposed status, but her firm faith and political stance gradually took shape.

points.title: 王位继承人
points.description: 1543年，亨利八世通过《继承法案》重新确立玛丽为王位继承人，但前提是她必须承认英国国教和父亲作为教会最高权威的地位。玛丽在表面上妥协，但私下仍保持天主教信仰。在爱德华六世统治期间，她被排除在权力核心之外，但作为天主教徒的代表，她逐渐成为反对新教改革势力的象征。这一时期，玛丽在伦敦的生活相对平静，但她始终关注政治局势，为未来可能的统治做准备。
points.descriptionEn: In 1543, Henry VIII restored Mary to the line of succession through the Third Act of Succession, but only on the condition that she recognize the Church of England and her father as its Supreme Head. Mary complied superficially while maintaining her Catholic faith privately. During Edward VI's reign, she was excluded from the centers of power but emerged as a symbol of opposition to Protestant reform as the leading Catholic figure. During this period, Mary lived relatively peacefully in London but remained attentive to political developments, preparing for a possible future reign.

points.title: 英格兰女王
points.description: 1553年7月，玛丽成功登上英格兰王位，成为英格兰第一位正式加冕的女王。她立即着手恢复天主教为英格兰国教，废除了爱德华六世时期的新教改革措施。1554年，她与西班牙国王腓力二世结婚，这一婚姻引发了英格兰民众的不安，担心国家被西班牙控制。在统治期间，她镇压新教异端，约有300名新教徒被处死，这一行为为她赢得了'血腥玛丽'的绰号。尽管如此，她也致力于改善教育和医疗系统，并修复与教皇的关系。
points.descriptionEn: In July 1553, Mary successfully ascended the English throne, becoming England's first officially crowned queen. She immediately began restoring Catholicism as the state religion, reversing the Protestant reforms of Edward VI's reign. In 1554, she married King Philip II of Spain, a union that caused anxiety among English people who feared Spanish control. During her reign, she suppressed Protestant dissent, resulting in the execution of approximately 300 Protestants, earning her the nickname 'Bloody Mary.' Despite this, she also worked to improve education and healthcare systems and restored relations with the Pope.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1558年11月17日，玛丽一世在里士满宫去世，终年42岁，没有留下子嗣。她的妹妹伊丽莎白一世继承王位，重新确立了新教在英格兰的主导地位。玛丽的统治虽然短暂，但对英格兰宗教和政治产生了深远影响。她恢复天主教的尝试最终失败，但她作为英格兰第一位正式加冕的女王，为后来的女性统治者铺平了道路。'血腥玛丽'的称号反映了她对新教徒的残酷镇压，但也掩盖了她作为女性统治者在男性主导的欧洲政治舞台上的成就和挑战。
points.descriptionEn: On November 17, 1558, Mary I died at Richmond Palace at the age of 42, without leaving an heir. Her sister Elizabeth I succeeded to the throne, re-establishing Protestantism as the dominant religion in England. Although her reign was brief, it had profound effects on English religion and politics. Her attempt to restore Catholicism ultimately failed, but as England's first officially crowned queen, she paved the way for future female rulers. The nickname 'Bloody Mary' reflects her harsh suppression of Protestants but also obscures her achievements and challenges as a female ruler in the male-dominated European political landscape.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为玛丽一世是一位坚定的天主教信仰捍卫者，在宗教改革浪潮中坚守传统信仰。她致力于恢复英格兰与罗马教廷的关系，维护天主教礼仪和传统。作为英格兰第一位正式加冕的女王，她打破了性别障碍，证明了女性能够有效统治国家。她的婚姻政策虽然引发争议，但也旨在为英格兰带来稳定和欧洲影响力。玛丽的统治代表了天主教传统的延续，对英格兰宗教文化的发展有重要意义。
supporter.en: Supporters view Mary I as a steadfast defender of the Catholic faith, standing firm against the tide of the Reformation. They commend her efforts to restore England's relationship with the Roman Catholic Church and preserve Catholic liturgy and traditions. As England's first officially crowned queen, she broke gender barriers, proving that women could effectively rule a nation. Though her marriage policies were controversial, they aimed to bring stability and European influence to England. Mary's reign represented the continuation of Catholic tradition and was significant for the development of England's religious culture.

critic.zh: 批评者指责玛丽一世通过残酷手段镇压新教徒，约有300名宗教改革者被处死，这一行为使她获得了'血腥玛丽'的臭名。她的宗教政策导致社会分裂和不稳定，经济也因与西班牙的战争而受损。她与西班牙国王腓力二世的婚姻使英格兰卷入欧洲大陆的权力斗争，违背了国家利益。此外，她未能成功解决王位继承问题，导致在她死后英格兰再次陷入宗教动荡。批评者认为她的统治是英格兰历史上的一段黑暗时期。
critic.en: Critics accuse Mary I of brutally suppressing Protestants, with approximately 300 religious reformers executed, earning her the notorious nickname 'Bloody Mary.' Her religious policies caused social division and instability, and the economy suffered due to wars with Spain. Her marriage to King Philip II of Spain drew England into European power struggles, contrary to national interests. Additionally, she failed to resolve the succession issue, leading to further religious turmoil after her death. Critics view her reign as a dark period in English history.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，玛丽一世是一位复杂的统治者，她的统治反映了16世纪欧洲宗教冲突的激烈程度。作为女性君主，她面临着特殊的挑战和期望。她的宗教政策虽然失败，但代表了天主教传统的最后挣扎。'血腥玛丽'的称号反映了历史记忆的塑造过程，将她的统治简化为宗教迫害，而忽视了她作为女性统治者的成就。在流行文化中，她常被妖魔化，但现代历史研究试图更全面地理解她的统治动机和时代背景，认识到她既是宗教冲突的产物，也是塑造历史的重要力量。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Mary I was a complex ruler whose reign reflected the intensity of religious conflicts in 16th-century Europe. As a female monarch, she faced unique challenges and expectations. Although her religious policies failed, they represented the final struggle of Catholic tradition. The nickname 'Bloody Mary' reflects the process of historical memory, reducing her reign to religious persecution while overlooking her achievements as a female ruler. In popular culture, she is often demonized, but modern historical research seeks to more fully understand her motivations and historical context, recognizing her as both a product of religious conflict and a force that shaped history.

self.zh: 我宁愿在英格兰失去我的头颅，也不愿在我的灵魂中失去我的信仰。
self.en: I would rather lose my head in England than lose my faith in my soul.

others.zh: 玛丽女王是一位虔诚但不幸的女性，她的统治被宗教狂热所扭曲，最终成为英格兰历史上最黑暗的篇章之一。
others.en: Queen Mary was a pious but unfortunate woman whose reign was distorted by religious fanaticism and ultimately became one of the darkest chapters in English history.
